name: B-Side
description: Your music library, inside Orca: browse, search and play your own collection with AIMP

cover.alt: B-Side logo, the words "Your music library, inside Orca" and two panels of a demo library: the Albums grid and Now Playing with synced lyrics

screenshots.alt: The panel in three skins: CD in a cover's colours, Vinyl with serif lyrics and a dark knob with a gold ring, Cassette with pixel type and cyan
screenshots.caption: Three skins: CD, Vinyl and Cassette

screenshots.alt: The panel dragged wide: a demo Albums grid on the left, Now Playing on the right with cover, the format line, synced lyrics and controls
screenshots.caption: Browse your collection beside what is playing

screenshots.alt: Synced lyrics in the three skins at three sizes, the current line highlighted, with the A- and A+ buttons in the corner
screenshots.caption: Synced lyrics, at the size you read best

screenshots.alt: The CD skin with three demo covers, each tinting the whole panel in its own colours, with the format line of each track
screenshots.caption: CD takes its colours from every cover

screenshots.alt: Search for "rio" finding the artist Ríos de Ámbar, the album Río Lento and its tracks, beside that album's page
screenshots.caption: Instant search that ignores accents

screenshots.alt: Each skin's logo, paused and playing: a glowing CD, a turntable whose tonearm lowers onto the record, a pixel tape with its light on
screenshots.caption: A logo that plays and pauses with the music

settings.title: Library folders
settings.description: Folders with your music, one per line (for example C:\Users\you\Music). Leave empty to use the Windows Music folder. B-Side only reads them; files that are only in the cloud (OneDrive Files On-Demand) are listed by name and never downloaded.
